plan.title: SRC-AWD-002 — Award Vendor A and approve proposal

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared awarding flow.
Allocate all 10 units on the only line to Vendor A.
Verify that the line is fully allocated, Vendor A is the only selected vendor in the available two-bid state, and the proposal total is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Create and submit the award proposal for Vendor A using the catalog's complete award flow.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark using the available pending-approver session.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase order.
Verify that the resulting purchase order contains the single awarded line with quantity 10.
